node.title: Re^2: To count number of files created yesterday in a directory
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
glob "*.*";

Note that the above glob will only match files/dirs containing a dot. If memory serves, this is a Microsoftism because in their world a simple glob "*" doesn't match all entries like it would on other platforms.

Luckily there are things like [metamod://File::Glob] to help with making such actions platform-independent.
